status: Post-training numerical diagnostic frozen before any selected-checkpoint probability probe
scenario_distribution: make_scenario(split=train) on a disjoint seed; no train/val/heldout dataset rows reused
target: At least one marked top-to-refractory event strictly inside each positive-length propagation interval, conditional on its exact starting finite state
probability: 1 - e_i exp(Q_killed * dt) 1; zero only marked off-diagonal q[top,ref], keep original diagonal
sanity_rule: Each of five seeds AND pooled residual magnitude <=4 with no deterministic-probability contradiction; zero variance with any contradiction fails, even when residuals cancel; empty/invalid records reject
inference_qualification: Predictable-variance martingale sanity diagnostic; not an exact normal test, not independent real-world predictive or biological calibration
